name: Hive 1.14.0
notes: Local-model harness: Ollama is now spoken natively, so a runtime's context window, keep-alive, and "Let the model think" settings actually reach the server, and a capability probe learns what each model can do. Local models can call your MCP tools: with the runtime's Supports tools switch on and a model that reports tool support, Ollama turns run the same multi-round tool loop as the API runtimes, with calls and results shown live under the bubble. A Models panel on every Ollama runtime lists what is installed on that server (with a loaded badge and its context window), pulls or updates tags with per-layer progress and cancel, removes models, and points the runtime at one with Use. Reasoning models' <think> output is split from the reply and streamed to the thinking channel instead of the transcript; remote-LAN and Tailscale endpoints get a connect timeout, one reconnect, an idle timeout that any activity resets, and errors that name the host. Small local models get a short identity block so they stop guessing what they run on.
